title: Risk prediction of covid-19 related death and hospital admission in adults after covid-19 vaccination: national prospective cohort study.

model.rationale: All factual claims in the generated text are directly supported by the reference article. Study design, cohort characteristics (6.9 million vaccinated adults), methods (cause-specific Cox regression, fractional polynomials, multiple imputation, independent validation), results (hazard ratios for comorbidities, C-statistic 92.5, R² 74.1%, sensitivity 78.7%), and discussion/limitations are accurately reproduced without fabrication. No unsupported statements or critical omissions were identified.
